name: Emargy GEO – AI Visibility for WooCommerce
author: emargy

sections.description:
Emargy GEO helps WooCommerce stores prepare product information for search engines, shopping systems, and AI-assisted discovery.

The free plugin provides a useful visibility foundation without requiring an account, license key, or external AI service.

Unlike a generic llms.txt generator, Emargy GEO works at the WooCommerce product layer. It audits merchant-critical attributes, publishes product and variation schema, coordinates output with major SEO plugins, and creates catalog and sitemap endpoints from the same product data.

Included in the free plugin

  • Merchant Readiness audits for published WooCommerce products.
  • Product and variation structured data.
  • Compatibility Mode for Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, and SEOPress.
  • A product visibility panel for brand, identifiers, category, and indexability signals.
  • A public llms.txt store summary.
  • A paginated /ai-catalog JSON endpoint.
  • Product, image, category, content, and AI-discovery sitemaps.
  • Optional WooCommerce dataLayer events with Consent Mode v2 defaults.
  • Manual company, social, and SEO settings.

Designed to avoid duplicate SEO output

Automatic Compatibility Mode detects supported SEO plugins and defers overlapping metadata. The compatibility dashboard explains which component controls each output.

No account or AI key required

Emargy GEO Free processes catalog information on your WordPress site. It does not require an Emargy account and does not send product data to Emargy.

Need more automation?

Emargy GEO Pro adds static Google Merchant XML/TSV feeds, feed validation, AI-assisted content suggestions, category suggestions, and reviewed bulk fixes. The free features remain useful without upgrading.

Learn more at emargy.com/products/emargy-geo.

Privacy

Emargy GEO Free does not include telemetry and does not send store or product data to Emargy.

When the optional Google Tag Manager integration is enabled, the visitor’s browser may send commerce event data to Google according to the store owner’s Google configuration and consent setup. Store owners are responsible for their privacy notice and consent requirements.

The public llms.txt, sitemap, and AI Catalog endpoints expose information derived from published, indexable store content. Token protection is available for the AI Catalog.

External services

Google Tag Manager

Google Tag Manager is optional and is not contacted by default. Its script is loaded from googletagmanager.com only when a store administrator enables tracking and saves a Google Tag Manager container ID.

When enabled, the visitor’s browser can send the current page context and WooCommerce commerce events to Google. Depending on the page and the store’s container configuration, event data may include product IDs or SKUs, product names, categories, brand, prices, currency, quantities, cart or order totals, transaction ID, tax, shipping, and coupon codes. Consent Mode v2 defaults can be enabled so advertising and analytics storage begin in a denied state until the store’s consent management platform updates consent.

This service is provided by Google LLC: Google Terms of Service and Google Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the emargy-geo folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the WordPress plugin screen.
  3. Activate Emargy GEO – AI Visibility for WooCommerce.
  4. Open Emargy GEO > Getting Started.
  5. Confirm Compatibility Mode, then run the Merchant Readiness audit.
  6. Review llms.txt and the AI Catalog from Emargy GEO > AI Discovery.
sections.faq:
Does the free plugin require a license key?

No. All features shipped in the WordPress.org version work without a license key or Emargy account.

Does Emargy GEO send my products to an external service?

The plugin generates audits, schema, sitemaps, llms.txt, and AI Catalog output on your own WordPress site. It does not send this data to Emargy. If you explicitly enable the optional Google Tag Manager integration, visitors’ browsers can send the commerce events described under External services to Google.

Does this guarantee that AI assistants will recommend my products?

No. The plugin improves machine-readable product information and discovery endpoints. Search engines and AI services independently decide what they crawl, index, cite, or recommend.

Will it conflict with my SEO plugin?

Emargy GEO detects Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, and SEOPress. Automatic Compatibility Mode defers overlapping metadata while retaining commerce-specific checks and discovery features. Always verify structured data on a staging site after changing SEO plugins.

What information appears in the AI Catalog?

Published, indexable WooCommerce product information such as name, URL, description, price, availability, identifiers, brand, images, and categories. Products excluded in plugin settings or marked noindex are omitted.

Can I make the AI Catalog private?

Yes. Enable token protection in Settings. Requests must then include the generated catalog token.

Does analytics tracking load automatically?

Commerce dataLayer events are optional. Google Tag Manager is loaded only when tracking is enabled and a valid container ID is configured. Consent Mode v2 can default analytics and advertising storage to denied.

What data is removed on uninstall?

Nothing is removed by default. Enable Delete plugin settings and audit data when uninstalled before uninstalling if you want the plugin to remove its options, audit table, cached discovery output, and product metadata.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Added Merchant Readiness audits and stored issue summaries.
  • Added product, variation, organization, website, breadcrumb, and article schema controls.
  • Added llms.txt, AI Catalog, and discovery sitemaps.
  • Added compatibility detection for popular SEO plugins.
  • Added optional dataLayer tracking with Consent Mode v2 defaults.
